addresses.name: CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces
addresses.comment: **Keeps the agent's list of provinces threatened by a landing** (+0x1DC/+0x1E0/+0x1E4), every hour from CAIUnit::Tick (0x4B0A20, row 10), before anything that reads it. 0x4B1820 to the `ret 4` at 0x4B1D03. (1) **Pruning**: each listed province p stays only while it is in the agent's own theatre (p +0x380/+0x384 against the agent's area id +0x68/+0x6C) and some edge of p leads to a sea province (template is_land clear, simulated set) holding a land unit (slot 15) whose **next step** (the first node of its path, CUnit +0x138, with +0x140 > 0) is p and whose owner is not us and is hostile to us - at war (CDiplomacyStatus +0x20), REB on either side, or an undeclared war covering the unit's province (UndeclaredWarCoversProvince). Otherwise p's node is unlinked and freed (or, while the list's no-unlink byte +0x1E8 is set, marked at node +0xC) and the walk goes on. (2) **Adding**: for each id pair on the agent's sighted list (+0x25C, resolved through the persistent-id tables 0x1A857F0/0x1A857F4), every land unit the sighted unit carries (CUnit +0x2E4, the fleet's `carrying` list) whose path has a **last node** (+0x13C) in a province we own (+0x330 == agent +0x38) adds that province if it is not listed. No hostility test in (2). **What else adds**: CAIUnit_AddThreatenedProvince (0x4D56A0), from SetUnitPath (0x1C9CB7) when a land unit standing at sea is given a one-province path into a land province held by an enemy of its owner - the theatre agent of that province (CTheatre_GetUnit's +0x198, an AI unit agent by slot 65) is told at once. **Readers**: CAIUnit::Tick runs slot 80 every hour while +0x1E4 > 0; CAIUnit::RebuildHoldProvinces adds 200.0 to a threatened province's hold score (0x4B467B-0x4B46A5); CAIUnit_FillGarrisons (0x4CACB0) raises a threatened hold province's garrison want by the brigades of hostile land units heading into it and never takes a garrison out of one. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section A.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::PositionLandUnits
addresses.comment: **The land block's first call: where the agent's divisions stand** - row 15 of CAIUnit::Tick (0x4B0BC2), on the full pass or, at war / in an undeclared war / with provinces in revolt, every third hour. 0x4CC450 to the bare `ret` at 0x4CC68E; agent in ECX. Nothing for a non-root agent that has an area (the ManageLandUnits gate). Positions = the scored ops-area records +0x2C0 with their map +0x2D0, or at plan stance 0 the hold positions +0x2FC/+0x30C. n = the committed divisions' copy (+0x13C..+0x140). **Allied-soil budget**: n/2 when the country leads a real faction (CCountry +0xD8 slot 7, CFaction ReturnTrue / CNullFaction ReturnFalse, and its first member is us), else n/5 when the acting capital's area borders an area at war with it (COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea, 0x7FD90, reader F's), else n/3 - truncated - less divisions_on_allied_soil (+0x348). Then CAIUnit_SplitGarrisonAndLine (0x4C7AB0) gives a garrison count and a line count; with a line count and positions, CAIUnit_FillLinePositions (0x4C8EE0); **only if that moved nothing**, with a garrison count, CAIUnit_FillGarrisons (0x4CACB0); **only if neither moved anything**, with held-back divisions (+0x15C) and a second ring (+0xA0), CAIUnit_PlaceReserves (0x4CB840). full_pass_pending (+0x84) cleared. Answers whether any of the three moved a unit; Tick drops it.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_SplitGarrisonAndLine
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CAIUnit_SplitGarrisonAndLine(CAIUnit* agent, CList* positions, void* garrisonDivisions, CList* garrisonTargets, int* garrisonCount, int* lineCount)
addresses.comment: 0x4C7AB0 to the `ret 0x18` at 0x4C8EA5, read whole. (1) **Garrison divisions**: over +0x13C, a division with a brigade of type garrison_brigade (CSubUnitDataBase +0x50) gets CUnit +0x2C9 (ai_garrison) = 1 and goes into the output vector; one without, already flagged, stays only while it stands in land we control and is not a role-8 army with air transports about (+0x10C), else its flag is cleared. (2) **Garrison targets**: the hold list +0x17C (slot 80's, best first) - a record of score >= 20.0 in land we control goes onto `garrisonTargets` by descending score, unless it is an ops-area province of under 10 victory points that is not its own depot; for the human's delegated AI (runs_units clear) a province holding a friendly land unit of another agent is skipped; strong = records of score >= 50.0. (3) **The counts**, n = |+0x13C|, posCap = 10 x |positions|: no positions -> garrison = n; no hold provinces (+0x184 == 0) -> line = n - |garrison-brigade divisions|; else front = |+0xC0|, enemies = non-friend land units on front provinces whose controller IsFrontWorthyEnemy, areaSum = the sum of those provinces' areas' sizes; at war on the frontier (+0x364) front x2, front = max(front, areaSum < 7 ? 2 x enemies : enemies), strong = 1 when front <= enemies/3 and strong > 1, enemies x2; lineWant = min(max(enemies, front), posCap); garrison = min(min(+0x184, n), n - lineWant), raised to min(max(targets, |garrison-brigade divisions|) capped at n, n - front) when below that, then to strong; line = n - garrison, the excess over posCap handed back to the garrison. In a scenario game (gamestate +0xD0C) nine tenths of the garrison go to the line. (4) The targets are topped up from the rest of the hold list (any score, best first) until there are `garrison` of them. (5) Per region group (COwnerArea +0x6C) of the first `garrison` targets - the shortfall added to the theatre's largest area's group - the garrison divisions standing or heading there are cut to the group's count (dropping first the one without militia (+1000) or police (+500) whose hold score is lowest; garrison-brigade divisions never) and raised to it from divisions of +0x13C not flagged, standing or heading in the group, facing no country we prepare war on, and at war carrying no armour, light armour, heavy armour or mechanized brigade, nor paratroopers while air transports exist - the best by (10 x its garrison rating (slot 88, RateUnitAsGarrison) + (mean distance to the ops area + 10)/5) x 0.75 on a front province x (1.5 - its organisation share); each pick gets +0x2C9 = 1. The name is ours. See FINDINGS-moving.md, section A.3.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_FillLinePositions(CAIUnit* agent, CList* positions, void* positionMap, int lineCount, int* alliedSoilBudget)
addresses.comment: **The line: divides the line count among the positions and marches committed divisions (+0x12C) into them.** 0x4C8EE0 to the `ret 0x14` at 0x4CA9BD (0x4CA9C0 abuts with no padding - trap 2). Records are the 0x1C CAIProvinceRecord. (A) small fronts: front provinces (+0xC0) whose area holds <= 3 provinces and fewer than 5 enemy land units, and that a committed division stands or heads in. (B) per position in a friendly-controlled province: have and standing zeroed; a province whose only front neighbour is a small front gets want = -1000 (left out); else cap = CAIUnit_GetPositionCap, want = trunc(lineCount x score / ops_area_score_total +0x34C) capped at cap, the remainders carried (0 where score < 1.0 and the total >= 1.0). (C) CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(+0x12C, divisions only, allies too). (D) Nothing given: every position wants 1, or 2 where its province's units have a CUnit +0xC0 above 0. Else while the carry > 0.1, the position with the least want (+100 where want + 1 would pass cap, first of equals) gets one. Then where want > trunc(3.5 x cap) and the province's supplies (+0x164) are nought or its supply need (+0x24C) is at least five times them, want is cut to that and the excess handed to the other positions up to their own 3.5 x cap. (E) each committed division not in a garrison: it stays when bound for a position that wants it; otherwise it goes to the position (have < cap) best by have/want x 100 (+ the excess over 1 again), at war x the distance and (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 where a land battle is on, x 0.66 at a depot, x 0.66 beside a hostile-route province, less 50 x the unit's defensive terrain modifier there (slot 89, GetUnitTerrainModifier(province, unit, false)), that it can reach; failing one, to a second-ring province (+0xA0) picked by a MT19937 seeded with the unit's id. (F) each position still short pulls the division best by squared map distance x 16 + dig-in/100 + attack delay/1000 - 100 x its terrain modifier here (x 0.25 where its own position wants none, else + 100 x its terrain modifier where it is bound), able to reach and leave; none left -> CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition. Every move is CEU3AI::MoveUnit(unit, province, 0, safe, very safe). See FINDINGS-moving.md, section A.4.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition(CAIUnit* agent, CMapProvince* province, int have, int want)
addresses.comment: **Held-back divisions to a line position nobody else can fill.** 0x4CA9C0 to the `ret 0x10` at 0x4CACAB (abuts 0x4C8EE0's `ret 0x14` with no padding - trap 2). One caller, CAIUnit_FillLinePositions (0x4CA987). Nothing unless the frontier is at war (+0x364) and divisions are held back (+0x15C). The shortfall is want - have; with have > 0 it is sent only where the province is beside a hostile-route province (+0x1BC) or has a land battle (slot 11 == 1) whose slot 17 (the attacker's share) is above 500 (g_AiAreaWeightFloor). Answers whether it sent one. The name is ours.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_FillGarrisons
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_FillGarrisons(CAIUnit* agent, void* garrisonDivisions, CList* garrisonTargets, int garrisonCount)
addresses.comment: 0x4CACB0 to the `ret 0x10` at 0x4CB7FD. Candidates are the garrison divisions, plus - when the agent's country is the one played - every division of it with no agent above it. CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(candidates, targets, any land unit, no allies). Each target in list order wants |garrisonDivisions| / |targets|, the first remainder ones one more; a threatened province (+0x1DC) adds the brigades of the hostile land units heading into it (CollectUnitsMovingIntoProvince with enemiesOnly); the want is held to the stack cap, round(0.5 / (-BASE_STACKING_PENALTY)) (20 where that is not above nought). While have < want: the candidate not in a battle, not retreating, free to leave (UnitMayLeave strict), standing or heading in the target's area (or anywhere, where the target's area is one of the focus areas +0x338), not already there, not in a threatened province, and - unless the target is threatened - not taken from a hold position whose standing less one (none where that position scores less or the target is a depot) is no more than the target's have plus one for a non-depot, nearest by squared map distance (x 2 for an army of role 5 leaving a higher-scored position) and able to reach it, is moved there (MoveUnit 0, 1, 1). The name is ours.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_PlaceReserves
addresses.comment: **Held-back divisions to the rear.** 0x4CB840 to the `ret 4` at 0x4CBFE6. Builds a 0x1C record for each province of the second ring +0xA0 (friendly land two steps out) with cap = round(10 x effective infrastructure) (modifier 12 x (1000 + modifiers 13 and 14) / 1000, held between 10 and 1000), counts the held-back divisions into them, then for each held-back division (+0x15C) not retreating, not in a battle, with no blocking order (order slot 24 false) and not a garrison: unless it stands or heads in a ring province within its cap, it is looked at - beside a war candidate's province (IsWarCandidate) across a river or in a fort and fit (strength and organisation above 0.3) it stays; beside war-candidate land units and fit it stays unless our other idle divisions there number at least half of those units; otherwise it goes to the ring province, other than where it is bound, least by map distance + 20 x have - 30 x (its province's depot hops - that province's), with MoveUnit(0, 1, 1). Answers whether it moved one. The name is ours.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_CheckLandMarches
addresses.comment: **The land block's last call: each marching land unit's road checked.** 0x4CC020 to the `ret 4` at 0x4CC187. Over every land unit of the agent (+0x11C) not retreating with a destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince): with a path left and an order other than strategic redeployment (0x5A4), it is switched to strategic redeployment (CEU3AI::IssueUnitOrder 0x5A4) where CEU3AI_ShouldRedeployStrategically says so. Then every province of its path but the last that is held by a hostile country (at war, REB, or under an undeclared war covering it): a headquarters (oob_level < 4) is stood down; a division is stopped at its next step (MoveUnit(next, 0, 0, 0)) where that province's area is valid and has more than 3 provinces - posted again for each such province. addresses.name: CAIUnit_PlanParadrops
addresses.comment: **The airborne planner**, called by CAIUnit::Tick only while the agent has air transports (+0x10C). 0x4CC690 to the `ret 4` at 0x4CD86F. k = min(|role-8 armies +0x16C|, |air transports|). addresses.name: CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(CAIUnit* this, void* units, CList* records, bool anyLandUnit, bool withAllies)
addresses.comment: Fills a position list's have (+0x10) and standing (+0x14). 0x4D9E30, two `ret 0x10`. For each land unit of the vector (divisions only unless anyLandUnit), not retreating or retreating with an organisation share >= 0.5: the records are walked in list order - the first that is its province counts it standing and heading (have and standing +1) unless it is bound for a province not held by an enemy, when it is counted nowhere; the first that is its destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince) counts it heading. With withAllies, focus areas (+0x340 > 0) and the frontier at war, it recurses over the whole unit list of every non-hostile country other than us that controls a focus area's first province. Callers: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions, CAIUnit_FillGarrisons, CAIUnit_PlaceReserves and itself. The name is ours.

structs.name: CAIProvinceRecord
structs.comment: The AI's 0x1C per-province record: ScoreOpsAreaProvinces' scored list (CAIUnit +0x2C0, map +0x2D0), RebuildOpsAreaProvinceRecords' hold positions (+0x2FC/+0x30C), slot 80's hold list (+0x17C), and the local lists of CAIUnit_PlaceReserves and CAIUnit_FallBackFromLosingDefences. No vftable.
structs.evidence: operator new(0x1C) and the seven-dword initialisation at 0x4BD491, 0x8CB840's record loop and 0x8D8380; field uses in 0x4C8EE0, 0x4CACB0, 0x4CB840, 0x4D9E30.

struct_fields.name: province
struct_fields.evidence: Every user dereferences it as a CMapProvince (+0xD0 id, +0x2B4 area).

struct_fields.name: aux
struct_fields.comment: Zero in the scored and hold lists. CAIUnit_FallBackFromLosingDefences writes 10.0 for a fallback province inside the ops area and 0 outside, and stops at the first record above 1.0 when an outside one exists.

struct_fields.name: score
struct_fields.comment: The priority; the lists are kept by it, highest first (CList_InsertByDescendingScore).

struct_fields.name: want
struct_fields.comment: Divisions wanted here, set by CAIUnit_FillLinePositions; -1000 marks a position left out (its only front neighbour a small front). Not written for a position in a province not held by a friend, which keeps what it had.

struct_fields.name: have
struct_fields.comment: Units standing here or bound here, counted by CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions and kept as moves are posted.

struct_fields.name: standing
struct_fields.comment: Units standing here now (not merely bound here).

struct_fields.name: cap
struct_fields.comment: The most divisions the position takes: CAIUnit_GetPositionCap for a line position; round(10 x effective infrastructure) for a reserve province.

struct_fields.name: ai_garrison
struct_fields.comment: **The division is one of its agent's garrisons.** Written only by CAIUnit_SplitGarrisonAndLine (0x4C7AB0): set for every division with a garrison_brigade (0x4C7BE2) and for each division picked to make up a region group's garrison (0x4C8E31); cleared when a flagged division is no longer in land we control or is an airborne army with transports about (0x4C7C90) and when it is dropped from an over-full group (0x4C89B9); and cleared with +0x2C8..+0x2CB as one dword by CAIUnit::ClearUnit (0x4BA0A2). While set the division is left out of the line (CAIUnit_FillLinePositions), the reserves (CAIUnit_PlaceReserves), the attack (CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits, 0x4D6CE0), CAIUnit::AssignToNearestCommand, CAIUnit::AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift and CAIUnit_PickProvinceAmongSubordinates.
struct_fields.evidence: fieldchain --field 0x2C9 over the whole image: 14 sites, the four byte stores all in 0x4C7AB0; the same scan for +0x2C8 finds slot 78's known writes (0x4B298B, 0x4B2CAC) as the positive control, and ClearUnit's dword store at 0x4BA0A2.

struct_fields.name: role8_armies_first
struct_fields.comment: The land units whose CArmy +0x2FC role is 8 (end +0x170) - **airborne**: CAIUnit_PlanParadrops loads them onto the air transports (+0x10C) with CLoadOnPlaneCommand and sends the planes on paradrop_mission; slot 78, the air-transport skip, the air body's transport-plane rebase and the line and garrison steps (which leave them out while transports exist) treat them alike.
